AmbientEffectsConfig.doc: Ambient effects played continuously around placed crates.

fields.doc: Ambient particles displayed around placed crates.

AnimationConfig.doc: Root configuration of a custom stage-based crate animation (`plugins/XaliCrates/animations/<id>.yml`).

fields.doc: Inventory size in slots (multiple of 9, from 9 to 54).
Default ticks each stage stays visible before advancing.
Ticks to keep the inventory open after the final stage before auto-closing.
Minimum number of `select-reward` slots the player must pick before advancing.
Symbol definitions used in `stages[].grid`.
Named filler items referenced by symbol in stage grids.
Unselected mystery chest item for `select-reward` slots.
Highlighted item shown after a player selects a `select-reward` slot.
Reveal settings for `open-selected-reward` slots.
Replacement for unselected `select-reward` slots after selection ends.
Clickable item for `reveal-reward` slots.
Clickable button for `next-stage` slots.
Ordered sequence of stages (1-indexed when referenced by `repeat-stage`).
Sound configuration for stages, clicks, and completion.
Particle effects played on animation completion.

AnimationEndEffects.doc: Visual effects played when a custom animation completes.

fields.doc: Particle bursts spawned at the player when the animation finishes.

AnimationItem.doc: One item used as a filler or interactive button inside a custom stage-based animation.

fields.doc: Material key (e.g. `gray_stained_glass_pane`, `chest`, `ender_chest`).
Optional display name.
Optional lore lines.
Adds an enchantment glint.
When true, sets the stack size to the slot number (1-indexed), useful for numbered mystery chests.
Optional custom model data integer.
Optional resource pack item model key.

AnimationSounds.doc: Sounds played during a custom animation.

fields.doc: Default sound played on every stage transition.
Sound played when the player clicks an interactive slot.
Sound played when the animation ends.

AnimationStage.doc: One stage (frame or loop) in a custom inventory animation.

fields.doc: Rows of comma-separated symbols (9 columns per row, e.g. `"F,F,F,R1,R,R1,F,F,F"`). Omit when repeating another stage.
1-based stage index to repeat (`0` means do not repeat another stage).
How many times to play `repeat-stage`.
Ticks this stage stays active (`0` uses `default-frame-ticks`, `-1` waits indefinitely for player interaction).
Persistent reward symbols to re-roll when entering this stage.
Winning slot coordinates as `"row,col"` (1-based) awarded when the animation completes on this stage.
Optional sound overriding `sounds.stage`.
Optional potion effects applied to the viewer on this stage.
Temporarily close or reopen the animation inventory on this stage.
Plays the Totem of Undying visual effect on the viewer.

AnimationSymbols.doc: Symbols used inside stage grids to place dynamic rewards, fillers and interactive controls.

fields.doc: Empty slot symbol.
Replaced with a freshly rolled random reward on every frame.
Persistent reward symbols (e.g. `R1`, `R2`) that keep the same rolled reward until listed in `reset-rewards`.
Replaced with a random entry from `fillers`.
Clickable mystery chest symbol; once `min-select` are picked, advances to the next stage.
Displays the player's selected mystery slots for reveal or instant award.
Clickable symbol that uncovers a random reward into the pool for `selected-reveal-reward`.
Displays rewards uncovered via `reveal-reward` in arbitrary positions.
Clickable button that advances to the next stage (pair with `stay-ticks: -1`).

AttributeSpec.doc: One attribute modifier on an item.

fields.doc: Attribute key (e.g. `attack_damage`, `max_health`).
Modifier amount.
Operation: `ADD_NUMBER`, `ADD_SCALAR`, or `MULTIPLY_SCALAR_1`.
Optional equipment slot group (`HAND`, `OFF_HAND`, `HEAD`, `CHEST`, `LEGS`, `FEET`, `ANY`).
Pattern key (e.g. `border`, `stripe_top`, `creeper`).
Dye color name (e.g. `RED`, `GOLD`, `BLUE`).
Time a player must wait between openings (`0s`, `30s`, `5m`, `1h 30m`).
Track the cooldown per placed crate location rather than globally per crate type.
Optional permission node that bypasses this cooldown.

CostConfig.doc: Economy cost settings for opening a crate (requires Vault or VaultUnlocked).

fields.doc: Money charged per opening (`0` disables economy cost).
Optional VaultUnlocked currency name; blank uses the default currency.
If true and `key.required` is true, players may pay with EITHER a key OR the economy cost instead of both.

CrateActionConfig.doc: One action executed when opening a crate.

fields.doc: What kind of action to execute.
Text or command payload. Placeholders: `%player%`, `%displayname%`, `%crate%`, `%cratename%`, `%key%`, `%reward%`, `%rarity%`.

CrateConfig.doc: Root configuration of a crate file (`plugins/XaliCrates/crates/<id>.yml`). The file name without `.yml` is the crate's identifier.

fields.doc: Whether players can open, place, or preview this crate.
Display name shown in messages, menus and animations (defaults to `crate-item.name` or the crate id).
Optional permission required to open this crate.
How placed instances of this crate behave (`STATIC`, `DYNAMIC`, or `LUCKY_CHEST`).
How placed instances appear in the world (block or entity).
Physical crate item given by `/xcrates givecrate` and shown in virtual crate menus.
Key requirement, physical key item, and key click commands.
Optional Vault economy cost and key-or-economy rules.
Cooldown rules per player or per crate location.
Animation selection, skipping, and inventory space behavior.
Hologram lines, animation, and temporary reward display.
Ambient particles displayed around placed crates.
Default effects played when this crate is opened.
Per-rarity overrides for actions, sounds, particles, and fireworks.
Lucky chest spawn rules when `obtain` is `LUCKY_CHEST`.
Custom XaliMenu menu bindings for previewing or multi-crate browsing.
Multi-crate hub configuration.
All rewards belonging to this crate, keyed by reward id.

CrateDisplayConfig.doc: World display settings for a placed crate.

fields.doc: Whether the placed crate is a block or an entity.
Entity type name when `kind` is `ENTITY` (e.g. `ARMOR_STAND`, `VILLAGER`, `ENDER_CRYSTAL`).
Optional custom name tag displayed on the entity.
Players within this many blocks of a placed instance of this crate cannot see each other while they stand there. `0` (the default) or less turns it off.

CrateItem.doc: Clean, typed item definition used for crate items, key items, reward display items, and bonus reward items. Supports vanilla materials as well as `head:<player>`, `texture:<base64>`, `nexo:<id>`, `itemsadder:<id>`, and `hdb:<id>`.

fields.doc: Material key or custom source prefix (`diamond`, `chest`, `head:Notch`, `texture:<b64>`, `nexo:<id>`, `itemsadder:<id>`, `hdb:<id>`).
Stack count, from 1 to 99.
Custom display name. Supports legacy `&` codes, hex (`&#RRGGBB`), CMI gradients and MiniMessage.
Lore lines shown on the item.
Adds an enchantment glint without showing visible enchantments.
Durability damage applied to damageable items.
Legacy integer custom model data (`0` omits it).
Resource pack item model key, e.g. `mypack:crate_key`.
Whether the item cannot lose durability.
Map of enchantment key (e.g. `sharpness`, `unbreaking`) to level.
Bukkit item flags to hide attributes, enchants, potion effects, etc.
Leather armor or potion tint as `#RRGGBB`.
Custom potion effects applied to potions and tipped arrows.
Banner base dye color (e.g. `WHITE`, `RED`).
Banner patterns rendered in order.
Firework star / rocket metadata if this item is a firework.
Attribute modifiers applied to the item.
Optional raw SNBT / component data preserved during SpecializedCrates migration.

CrateMenusConfig.doc: Custom XaliMenu menu bindings for a crate.

fields.doc: XaliMenu menu name opened to preview this crate's rewards (defaults to `menus.preview` from `config.yml`).
XaliMenu menu name opened when this crate is a multi-crate (defaults to `menus.crates` from `config.yml`).

FallbackRewardConfig.doc: Permission-gated fallback replacement for one-time or rank-locked rewards.

fields.doc: Permission node that triggers the fallback reward when the winning player already has it.
Reward id in the same crate to grant instead.
Optional permission that bypasses the fallback (defaults to `xalicrates.admin`).

FireworkConfig.doc: One firework launched on crate open or reward tier.

fields.doc: Primary burst colors as `#RRGGBB` or Bukkit color names (e.g. `AQUA`, `#FF5500`).
Fade colors as `#RRGGBB` or Bukkit color names.
Firework burst shape: `BALL`, `BALL_LARGE`, `STAR`, `BURST`, or `CREEPER`.
Whether the burst flickers.
Whether the burst leaves a trail.
Rocket flight power (`0` explodes almost immediately, `1`–`3` flies higher).

GiveItemConfig.doc: Controls giving the display item itself as part of a reward.

fields.doc: Whether to give the reward's `display-item` to the player.
Keep the `display-item`'s custom name on the given stack.
Keep the `display-item`'s lore on the given stack.

HologramAnimationConfig.doc: Animated text prefix cycling for crate holograms.

fields.doc: Animation style: `NONE`, `TEXT_CHANGE`, or `MULTI_LINE_CHANGE`.
Ticks between animation frames.
Color/formatting prefixes cycled across the lines.

HologramConfig.doc: Native Paper TextDisplay hologram settings above a placed crate.

fields.doc: Whether a hologram is displayed above placed instances of this crate.
Lines shown above the crate. Supports colors, MiniMessage and PlaceholderAPI.
Vertical offset in blocks added to the global `holograms.offset`.
Optional animation cycling prefixes across hologram lines.
Temporary line shown above the crate after a reward is won (blank disables it).
How long the temporary reward hologram stays visible (e.g. `3s`).
Extra vertical offset for the temporary reward hologram.

KeyClickCommands.doc: Commands bound to clicks while holding a crate key. Prefix with `player:` to run as the player instead of console.

KeyConfig.doc: Key item and interaction settings for a crate.

fields.doc: Whether a physical or virtual key is required to open this crate.
Physical key item definition.
Allows left-clicking in air or on a block while holding this key to open the reward preview menu.
Optional commands executed when clicking while holding this key.

LuckyChestConfig.doc: Settings for mining-spawned lucky chests (`obtain: LUCKY_CHEST`).

fields.doc: Spawn chance percentage per matching mined block (`0.0` to `100.0`, e.g. `1.0` = 1 in 100).
Whether `blocks` is a `WHITELIST` or a `BLACKLIST`.
Material names matched when mining (empty allows any block when WHITELIST).
World names where this lucky chest may spawn (empty allows all worlds).
Whether players must hold `xalicrates.luckychest` (or `xalicrates.luckychest.<id>`) to trigger spawns.
Optional per-crate despawn duration (e.g. `10m`); null inherits `lucky-chest.despawn-after` from `config.yml`.
Give the crate item directly instead of replacing the mined block; null inherits `config.yml`.

MultiCrateConfig.doc: Turns a crate into a multi-crate hub that opens a XaliMenu selection menu listing child crates.

fields.doc: Whether this crate acts as a multi-crate selector instead of rolling rewards directly.
Ordered list of crate ids exposed by this multi-crate (empty lists all enabled non-multi crates).

OpenEffectsConfig.doc: Effects triggered when a crate opens (or overridden per reward rarity tier).

fields.doc: Actions executed on open (messages, broadcasts, titles, actionbars, commands).
Sounds played on open.
Particle bursts spawned on open.
Fireworks launched on open.

OpenedSelectedItemConfig.doc: Configuration for the `open-selected-reward` reveal stage in pick-a-chest animations.

fields.doc: When true, selected slots immediately show the won reward without needing a click to reveal.
Default mystery item shown before clicking to reveal (when `reveal-instantly` is false and rarity isn't matched).
Optional per-rarity reveal items (keyed by reward rarity, e.g. `common`, `rare`, `legendary`).

OpeningConfig.doc: Opening animation, skip, and inventory space behavior for a crate.

fields.doc: Animation id: built-in (`instant`, `open-chest`, `roulette`, `csgo`, `menu`, `enclose`, `discover`, `discover-eula`) or a custom animation file from `animations/`.
Inventory title used by inventory animations (supports `%crate%` and color codes).
Whether closing the animation inventory early skips straight to the reward.
Whether the animation inventory automatically closes after finishing.
Empty inventory slots required before opening (`-1` inherits `crates.required-slots` from `config.yml`).
How full inventories are handled (`DENY`, `DROP`, or `REDEEM` via XaliRedeem). Null inherits `config.yml`.

ParticleConfig.doc: One particle emitter attached to an ambient crate or an opening burst.

fields.doc: Minecraft particle key (e.g. `flame`, `enchant`, `dust`, `happy_villager`, `portal`).
Geometric animation pattern around the crate.
Particles spawned per tick / burst.
Particle speed / extra parameter.
Spread along X, Y and Z (also used as radius for animated patterns).
Center offset relative to the crate block center.
Optional hex color `#RRGGBB` for `dust` / colorable particles.

PotionEffectSpec.doc: One potion effect on an item or animation stage.

fields.doc: Potion effect key (e.g. `speed`, `jump_boost`, `blindness`).
Effect duration in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
Zero-based amplifier (`0` is level I, `1` is level II).

RepeatConfig.doc: Controls whether a reward can repeat within multi-reward openings.

fields.doc: Percent chance (`0`–`100`) that this reward may be rolled again in the same multi-reward opening.
Maximum number of times this reward may be won in a single multi-reward opening (`0` = never repeat).

RewardConfig.doc: One reward entry inside a crate's `rewards` map.

fields.doc: Relative roll weight (higher = more likely; probability is `weight / sum(non-fallback weights)`).
Rarity tier id matching a key in the crate's `tiers` map (`default` uses the crate's base effects).
If true, this reward is always granted in addition to the rolled reward(s).
If true, this reward is excluded from random rolls and only granted via another reward's `fallback`.
Item shown in preview menus and animations (and optionally given via `give-item`).
Whether and how to give `display-item` to the player.
Extra physical items granted in addition to `display-item` / `commands`.
Console commands executed without a leading slash. Supports `{player}`, `%player%`, `%reward%`, and `%amountX-Y%`.
Commands executed by the winning player as themselves.
Other reward ids in this crate that are also granted whenever this reward is won.
Reward ids whose display items are packed inside this reward when `display-item` is a shulker box.
Optional permission-based fallback replacement.
Controls duplicate prevention in multi-reward animations.
Optional XaliRedeem routing (works when XaliRedeem is installed).

RewardRedeemConfig.doc: Optional XaliRedeem integration settings on a specific reward.

fields.doc: Delivery policy: `AUTO` (overflow only), `ALWAYS` (always store in XaliRedeem), or `NEVER` (drop overflow).
Optional static XaliRedeem voucher id to grant instead of storing an ad-hoc pending reward.
How many of `voucher` to grant when `voucher` is set.

SoundConfig.doc: One sound played on crate open or reward tier.

fields.doc: Minecraft sound key (e.g. `entity.player.levelup`, `block.chest.open`, `ui.button.click`).
Sound volume (`0.0` to `10.0`).
Sound pitch (`0.0` to `2.0`).
Optional formatted label for `%rarity%` placeholders (defaults to the tier key).
When true, this tier's effects replace the crate's default `effects` instead of adding to them.
Tier-specific actions.
Tier-specific sounds.
Tier-specific particle bursts.
Tier-specific fireworks.

UnselectedItemConfig.doc: Replacement item for slots that the player did NOT select during a selection stage.

fields.doc: Use a random filler item from `fillers`.
Specific filler symbol from `fillers` (overrides `item` when set).
Explicit item shown in unselected slots (default AIR).
